summary: IonQ filed an 8-K reporting that it received a Second Request from the FTC regarding its pending acquisition of SkyWater Technology via a two-step merger. The deal, announced January 25, 2026, will make SkyWater a wholly owned subsidiary. The Second Request extends the HSR waiting period until 30 days after substantial compliance by both parties. Closing is still expected in Q2 or Q3 2026, subject to HSR clearance and other customary conditions. No price terms or advisors were disclosed in this filing. Watch for FTC review timeline and potential concessions.
